审题.题型: 应用文（建议书）：为学生会举办演讲比赛写一份组织方案
任务: 写一个标题，点明这是一份关于组织演讲比赛的建议书
开头交代背景（学生会要办演讲比赛）和写作目的（提出组织方案）
写出比赛的主题（topic）和目的（aim）
写出选手怎么选拔（selection of contestants）和比赛流程（procedure）
结尾说明比赛的意义，礼貌收尾
审题.语气: 正式、清楚、有条理：写的是还没举办的比赛，通篇用一般将来时 will 描述安排；像一份可以直接照着执行的方案，时间、地点、人数、规则都写具体
审题.字数: 120—180 词（题目要求 at least 120 words but no more than 180 words）；标题不计入字数，本篇正文 176 词。写到 160—180 词最稳，绝不能超过 180 词
易错: 标题写在正文上方，实词首字母大写：A Proposal for Organizing a Speech Contest，句末不加句号
题目提示的 topic、aim、procedure、selection of contestants 四项都要写到，而且最好用 The topic、The aim、As for the procedure 这样的词直接点明，阅卷老师一眼就能找到
主题要写出具体的题目，并用引号括起来，实词首字母大写：“My Dream and My Responsibility”；只写 an interesting topic 等于没写
比赛还没办，描述安排一律用 will，不要混进过去时
流程要写具体：在哪里、什么时候、每人讲几分钟、怎么评分、怎么奖励，避免只写 There will be a final.

要求.原句: A Proposal for Organizing a Speech Contest
要求.说明: 标题用 A Proposal for + 动名词短语，紧扣题目的 a proposal for organizing the contest，写在正文上方，不计入字数。

要求.原句: Our student union is planning to hold a speech contest this semester.
要求.说明: 第一段两句：先说学生会要办演讲比赛（背景），再用 Here is my proposal for organizing it. 说明写作目的，简洁明了。

要求.原句: The topic of the contest will be “My Dream and My Responsibility,”
要求.说明: 用 The topic 开头直接点明主题，给出具体题目，并用 which 从句说明这个主题能让同学们思考什么。

要求.原句: The aim is to improve students’ public speaking skills, build their confidence and make campus life more vibrant.
要求.说明: 用 The aim is to 点明目的，三个并列的动词短语从能力、自信到校园生活，写得具体而全面。

要求.原句: The contest will be open to all students, and contestants will be selected in two rounds.
要求.说明: 先说比赛面向全体学生，再说分两轮选拔；下一句写清初赛的做法：各院系初赛，每院系推荐两名选手进入决赛。

要求.原句: As for the procedure, the final will be held in the university auditorium in late November.
要求.说明: 用 As for the procedure 直接点题，再写时间、地点、每人五分钟备稿演讲加一个评委提问、评分标准和奖励，流程完整具体。

要求.原句: The contest will be a valuable opportunity for students to show their talents and learn from one another.
要求.说明: 最后一段先说比赛的意义（展示才华、互相学习），再用 I hope my proposal will be helpful. 礼貌收尾。

要求.原句: Here is my proposal for organizing it.
要求.说明: 正文共 176 词（标题不计）：开头 2 句，主题和目的 2 句，选拔和流程 5 句，结尾 2 句，题目四项要求都写到了，没有超过 180 词。

思路.内容: A Proposal for Organizing a Speech Contest（关于组织演讲比赛的建议），写在正文上方
学生会本学期要办演讲比赛 → 下面是我的组织方案
主题：“我的梦想与我的责任”，鼓励同学们思考目标和社会角色 → 目的：提高公开演讲能力、增强自信、让校园生活更有活力
面向全体学生，两轮选拔 → 各院系初赛，推荐两人进决赛 → 决赛十一月下旬在礼堂举行 → 五分钟备稿演讲 + 回答评委一个问题 → 教师评审团按内容、语言、表达打分，前三名获证书和奖品
比赛是展示才华、互相学习的宝贵机会 → 希望我的建议有帮助

步骤.做法: 用 A Proposal for Organizing a Speech Contest，直接借用题目的 organizing the contest，实词首字母大写，写在正文上方。

步骤.标题: 两句话交代背景和目的
步骤.做法: 第一句用现在进行时 is planning to 说学生会正在筹划比赛；第二句 Here is my proposal for organizing it. 说明下面是我的方案，开头不绕弯子。
用 The topic of the contest will be “…” 给出具体题目，再用 which encourages … 说明主题的意义；下一句用 The aim is to + 三个动词短语写目的。
先用 will be open to all students 说明谁能报名，再用 will be selected in two rounds 说明分两轮；下一句写清初赛：Each department will hold a preliminary round and recommend two speakers for the final.
用 As for the procedure 点题，依次写决赛的时间地点、选手要做什么（five-minute prepared speech、answer a question）、谁来评分、按什么评分、怎么奖励。
用 a valuable opportunity for students to … 说出比赛的意义，回扣第二段的目的；最后用 I hope my proposal will be helpful. 结束。

句式.名称: The topic will be …, which encourages 主题说明句
句式.表达: 表达“比赛的主题是……，它鼓励大家……”，给出主题并说明主题的意义
句式.公式: The topic of + 活动 + will be “主题”, which encourages + 人 + to + 动词原形 …
句式.原句: The topic of the contest will be “My Dream and My Responsibility,” which encourages students to think about their goals and the role they can play in society
句式.原句译: 比赛的主题是“我的梦想与我的责任”，鼓励同学们思考自己的目标以及他们能在社会中发挥的作用
句式.讲解: The topic of … will be 直接点明主题，主题的题目用引号括起，实词首字母大写；which 指代这个主题，encourage sb. to do 意思是“鼓励某人做某事”；the role they can play in society 里 play a role 是“发挥作用”。只给题目不说意义，读者不知道为什么选它。

例句.en: The theme of the exhibition will be “Green Campus,” which encourages students to protect the environment.
例句.zh: 展览的主题是“绿色校园”，鼓励同学们保护环境。

例句.en: The topic of the essay contest will be “My Hometown,” which encourages students to write about their own lives.
例句.zh: 征文比赛的主题是“我的家乡”，鼓励同学们写自己的生活。

句式.名称: The aim is to do A, B and C 目的句
句式.表达: 表达“目的是做 A、B 并做 C”，一句话说出活动的几个目的
句式.公式: The aim is to + 动词1 …, 动词2 … and 动词3 …
句式.原句: The aim is to improve students’ public speaking skills, build their confidence and make campus life more vibrant
句式.原句译: 比赛的目的是提高同学们的公开演讲能力，增强他们的自信，并让校园生活更有活力
句式.讲解: The aim is to 后面接三个并列的动词短语，to 只写一次；三个目的从个人能力（public speaking skills）到心理（confidence）再到集体（campus life），由近及远。make campus life more vibrant 用 make + 宾语 + 形容词，vibrant 意思是“充满活力的”。

例句.en: The aim is to raise students’ awareness of health, encourage them to exercise and build a healthier campus.
例句.zh: 目的是提高同学们的健康意识，鼓励他们锻炼，建设更健康的校园。

例句.en: The aim is to help students learn new skills, make friends and enjoy their free time.
例句.zh: 目的是帮助同学们学习新技能、结交朋友、享受空闲时光。

句式.名称: will be open to … selected in two rounds 选拔句
句式.表达: 表达“比赛面向……，选手将分两轮选拔产生”，说明谁能参加、怎么选人
句式.公式: The contest will be open to + 人, and contestants will be selected in + 轮数
句式.原句: The contest will be open to all students, and contestants will be selected in two rounds
句式.原句译: 比赛面向全体学生，选手将通过两轮比赛选拔产生
句式.讲解: be open to 意思是“对……开放、面向……”；will be selected 用被动语态，重点是“选手怎样产生”；in two rounds 说出选拔办法，下一句再具体解释每一轮。题目的 selection of contestants 用这一句直接落实。

例句.en: The club will be open to all students, and new members will be chosen through an interview.
例句.zh: 社团面向全体学生，新成员将通过面试选出。

例句.en: The competition will be open to students of all grades, and winners will be selected by online voting.
例句.zh: 比赛面向各年级学生，获胜者将通过网络投票选出。

替换.en: Anyone who is interested can sign up.
替换.zh: 感兴趣的人都可以报名。

句式.名称: As for the procedure 点题过渡句
句式.表达: 表达“至于……（流程），……”，用短语直接点出下面要写题目的哪一项
句式.公式: As for + 名词（the procedure / the time / the activities）, 主语 + 谓语 …
句式.原句: As for the procedure, the final will be held in the university auditorium in late November
句式.原句译: 至于比赛流程，决赛将于十一月下旬在学校礼堂举行
句式.讲解: As for 意思是“至于、说到”，后面直接用题目里的词 the procedure，阅卷老师一眼就能找到这一项。主句写决赛的地点和时间，in late November 意思是“十一月下旬”。按题目提示写应用文时，用 As for 点出每一项是非常实用的办法。

例句.en: As for the time, the event will be held on the last Saturday of this month.
例句.zh: 至于时间，活动将在本月最后一个星期六举行。

例句.en: As for the activities, volunteers will clean the streets and plant trees.
例句.zh: 至于活动内容，志愿者们将清扫街道、植树。

句式.名称: score … based on …, and the top three 评分奖励句
句式.表达: 表达“评委将根据……打分，前几名将获得……”，写清评分标准和奖励
句式.公式: A panel of + 人 + will score + 名词 + based on + A, B and C, and the top three + 人 + will receive + 奖励
句式.原句: A panel of teachers will score the speeches based on content, language and delivery, and the top three speakers will receive certificates and prizes
句式.原句译: 由教师组成的评审团将根据内容、语言和表达给演讲打分，前三名选手将获得证书和奖品
句式.讲解: a panel of teachers 意思是“由教师组成的评审团”；score 在这里是动词“打分”；based on 后面列出三项评分标准，delivery 指演讲时的表达（语音、语调、仪态）；and 后面写奖励，the top three 意思是“前三名”。一句话把“谁评、怎么评、奖什么”写全。

例句.en: A panel of students will judge the paintings based on creativity and skill, and the top five works will be shown in the library.
例句.zh: 由学生组成的评审团将根据创意和技巧评选画作，前五名的作品将在图书馆展出。

例句.en: Teachers will grade the essays based on content and language, and the top three writers will receive book prizes.
例句.zh: 老师们将根据内容和语言给文章打分，前三名作者将获得图书奖品。

句式.名称: a valuable opportunity for … to 意义句
句式.表达: 表达“这将是……做某事的宝贵机会”，在结尾说出活动的意义
句式.公式: 活动 + will be a valuable opportunity for + 人 + to + 动词1 … and + 动词2 …
句式.原句: The contest will be a valuable opportunity for students to show their talents and learn from one another
句式.原句译: 这次比赛将是同学们展示才华、互相学习的宝贵机会
句式.讲解: opportunity for sb. to do sth. 意思是“某人做某事的机会”，valuable 意思是“宝贵的”；show their talents 和 learn from one another 两个动词短语，一个对个人、一个对大家。learn from one another（互相学习）是地道说法，不写 make progress together（总论中式英语黑名单）。

例句.en: The trip will be a valuable opportunity for students to see the world and learn about other cultures.
例句.zh: 这次旅行将是同学们开阔眼界、了解其他文化的宝贵机会。

例句.en: The job fair will be a valuable opportunity for graduates to meet employers and find suitable jobs.
例句.zh: 招聘会将是毕业生接触用人单位、找到合适工作的宝贵机会。

替换.en: … will provide a good chance for … to …

词汇.义: adj. 初步的；预备的（preliminary round 初赛）

挖空: The topic of the contest will be
the role they can play in society
默写.句式: The topic will be …, which encourages 主题说明句
默写.意义: 给出主题并说明主题意义的模板，征文、展览类题目都能用。

默写.句式: The aim is to do A, B and C 目的句
默写.意义: 一句话写出活动的三个目的，应用文写 aim 的万能句。

挖空: will be open to all students
will be selected in two rounds
默写.句式: will be open to … selected in two rounds 选拔句
默写.意义: 写清谁能参加、怎么选人。

挖空: recommend two speakers for the final
默写.句式: 要点：选拔写具体，谁来办初赛、每个单位推荐几人
默写.意义: 把“两轮选拔”落到可执行的细节上。

挖空: will be held in the university auditorium
默写.句式: As for the procedure 点题过渡句
默写.意义: 用题目里的词点出每一项，让阅卷老师一眼找到。

挖空: based on content, language and delivery
默写.句式: score … based on …, and the top three 评分奖励句
默写.意义: 一句话写全“谁评、怎么评、奖什么”。

挖空: a valuable opportunity for students to
默写.句式: a valuable opportunity for … to 意义句
默写.意义: 活动类应用文结尾说意义的高分句。

得分.说明: 题目提示的四项内容全部写到，而且用 The topic、The aim、selected in two rounds、As for the procedure 直接点明，一眼就能找到：主题（“我的梦想与我的责任”）、目的（演讲能力、自信、校园活力）、选拔（面向全体、院系初赛各推两人）、流程（时间地点、演讲加提问、评分标准和奖励）。每一项都写得具体、可执行，结尾说明比赛的意义，完全符合满分档“切题、内容充实”的要求。
引用: Here is my proposal for organizing it.
The topic of the contest will be “My Dream and My Responsibility,”
The aim is to improve students’ public speaking skills
contestants will be selected in two rounds
Each contestant will give a five-minute prepared speech and then answer a question from the judges.

得分.说明: 四段各管一件事：背景和目的 → 主题和目的 → 选拔和流程 → 意义和收尾。第三段先写两轮选拔，再写决赛，顺序就是比赛进行的顺序；The topic、The aim、As for the procedure 这些标志词把题目的四项清楚地分开，and then、and 把每一步连起来。结构清晰、衔接自然，这正是满分档在结构上的表现。
引用: Here is my proposal for organizing it.
and then answer a question from the judges
I hope my proposal will be helpful.

得分.说明: 通篇用一般将来时描述还没举办的比赛，时态统一。句式有变化：which 引导的非限制性定语从句、The aim is to 后接三个并列动词短语、被动语态 will be selected / will be held、As for 点题、based on 说明评分标准。用词准确又地道，如 vibrant、preliminary round、auditorium、a panel of teachers、delivery、learn from one another。全文没有语法错误，符合满分档对语言的要求。
引用: which encourages students to think about their goals and the role they can play in society
Each department will hold a preliminary round
the final will be held in the university auditorium in late November
A panel of teachers will score the speeches based on content, language and delivery

升格.原句: The aim is to improve students’ public speaking skills, build their confidence and make campus life more vibrant.

步骤.写法: The aim is to improve students’ ability.
步骤.说明: 目的写到了，但 ability 太空泛（总论黑名单），看不出是什么能力。

步骤.写法: The aim is to improve students’ public speaking skills.
步骤.说明: 写出具体是公开演讲能力，和演讲比赛紧扣；但只有一个目的，略显单薄。

步骤.写法: The aim is to improve students’ public speaking skills and build their confidence.
步骤.说明: 加上 build their confidence，从能力写到心理；最后再加 make campus life more vibrant，从个人写到整个校园，三个目的由近及远，内容更充实。

升格.原句: Each contestant will give a five-minute prepared speech and then answer a question from the judges.

步骤.写法: Each contestant will give a speech.
步骤.说明: 流程只写了一步，演讲多长、有没有准备、还要不要答题，都没说。

步骤.写法: Each contestant will give a five-minute speech.
步骤.说明: five-minute 作定语（中间有连字符，minute 用单数）写出时长，规则具体了一些。

步骤.写法: Each contestant will give a five-minute prepared speech and answer some questions.
步骤.说明: prepared 说明是备稿演讲，又加上答题环节，流程更完整；最后改成 and then answer a question from the judges，用 then 写出先后顺序，说清是谁提问、问几个。

升格.原句: A panel of teachers will score the speeches based on content, language and delivery, and the top three speakers will receive certificates and prizes.

步骤.说明: 只说谁来选，没说按什么标准选、获奖者得到什么。

步骤.写法: A panel of teachers will score the speeches based on content and language.
步骤.说明: a panel of teachers 写出评审团，based on 写出评分标准，评选变得公正透明。

步骤.写法: A panel of teachers will score the speeches based on content, language and delivery, and the winners will get prizes.
步骤.说明: 补上 delivery（演讲时的表达），演讲比赛的三项标准齐了，又加上奖励；最后把 the winners will get prizes 改成 the top three speakers will receive certificates and prizes，写清几个人获奖、得到什么，receive 也比 get 正式。
